_comment: Golden reasoning cases — SYNTHETIC charts only (CLAUDE.md rule: never real birth data).
Placements are constructed rasi maps, hand-annotated with the expected promise-gate
outcome per docs/REASONING_LAYER_UPGRADE_PLAN.md §7. Expand toward ~20 charts with
chief-specialist annotation before flag-on (astrological review gate, plan §8).

cases.name: denied_marriage
cases.annotation: Gemini lagna; 7th lord Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn = 8th house (dusthana + affliction); Venus debilitated in Virgo in both D1 and D9 → chart does not promise marriage. A strong Venus dasha must NOT lift this (D1).

cases.name: delayed_marriage
cases.annotation: Aries lagna; 7th lord Venus own-sign in Libra (7th, kendra), Venus own-sign in D9 → PASS gate. Dasha excludes Venus/7th-lord → timing not yet active: promised, not now.

cases.name: promised_and_timed_marriage
cases.annotation: Same promised chart as delayed_marriage, but Venus dasha is running and transit Venus sits on the 7th → promised AND timed. Regression guard: the gate must not dim genuinely strong charts.
